name: Fair Work Ombudsman free help for international students
summary: Free workplace advice and help with underpayment or exploitation for international students, with protections so reporting doesn't put your visa at risk.
key: It is safe and free for you if you need help.
who: All workers in Australia, including international students
how: Contact the Fair Work Ombudsman through fairwork.gov.au; anonymous reports are possible
catches: Home Affairs generally won't cancel your visa if there is evidence your workplace rights were breached
Services available in different languages, free

source.label: Study Australia: Get help from the Fair Work Ombudsman

evidence.quote: It is safe and free for you if you need help.
The FWO gives advice and support to all workers in Australia, including international students.
Your visa will not be cancelled if you come forward with genuine complaints about your working conditions.
